content:
The **Springhill Golf Course** is a location in Appalachia, part of the Whitespring grounds. [1] [2] 

As part of 2080 Initiative, the golf course was redesigned "for a new era of sport" under the direction of lead architect Ryan Ainsley. [1] In July 2077, a staff bulletin was sent out, informing employees that the course was slated for opening with an exhibition tournament in the fall. [3] 

The driving range contains several golf clubs, and serves as the home of Fritz, who will don a Hazmat Suit in case of nuclear blast.

A skeleton is found in the hole northeast of the Golf Club, protruding out of the dirt, which may be holding a Nuka-Cola Quantum. There is a 50% chance that the skeleton will not be holding anything, a 37.5% chance of it holding an empty Nuka-Cola bottle, and a 12.5% chance of it being a Quantum. [4] 

The Springhill Golf Course appears in *Fallout 76*.
